items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I saw Harold as soon as I got to New York... He said, well come on up to the Woodside and share my place... it was like a little family there.

ctx.x: Is it true that all the major horn players carried their own rhythm sections for jam sessions?

No, they didn't carry them but they had their favorites. But in Chicago we would find Lester because -- and he loved to play with us. You know. We knew all the tunes and we had the beat that he liked, and so we would just jam all night long. All the different --- hang out and just play. And so when I went to New York, Harold left and went to New York before I did. And on the spur of the moment I decided to go to New York. I didn't have any money, and I saw Harold as soon as I got to New York, and he asked me what…

to the Woodside and share my place. So I took my trunk, my bag and went up there, and Lester was living up there. And they --- Harold was a great cook, and we all would just stay there and wait for Harold to cook and Lester would wait for Harold to cook, and we just had -- it was like a little family there. And --
